adjudication.rationale: In app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb the `update` action (used by PUT /admin/customize/embedding per routes.rb) does not read any params or modify any persisted state; it only re-renders the current `@embedding` OpenStruct via `render_serialized`. On the client, admin-embedding controller defines `saveChanges()` which calls `this.get('embedding').update({});`, i.e., it will issue an update request and treat a 200 as success even though the server-side update endpoint is a no-op. This matches the finding that a save can report success while saving nothing.

adjudication_records.issue_text: spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb:6 — New controller specs assert only class inheritance, so create, update and destroy are entirely unexercised and the suite stays green while each of those endpoints 500s on unverified input

adjudication.rationale: The new specs for Admin::EmbeddableHostsController only assert inheritance and do not exercise create/update/destroy behavior. In the controller code, update/destroy do `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` without handling `host == nil`, which would raise `NoMethodError` (500) for an invalid/missing id. Likewise `save_host` dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `[:category_id]` without guarding against missing `embeddable_host` params, also leading to 500 on malformed input. The trivial specs would not catch these failure modes, so the finding is grounded in the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — No unique index or validation on host combined with .first and no ORDER BY means duplicate host rows route embedded topics to a nondeterministic category that can flip after any row update

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces EmbeddableHost.record_for_host, which selects `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` with no ORDER BY. The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no unique index on `host`, and the model adds no `validates_uniqueness_of` (case-insensitive) to prevent duplicates. Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create also allows creating rows freely. If duplicate host rows exist (potentially with different `category_id`), callers like `TopicEmbed.import` (`eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` then `category: eh.try(:category_id)`) can pick an arbitrary matching row; without ORDER BY SQL does not guarantee which row `.first` returns, so the chosen category can be nondeterministic.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:197 — The new plural hydration branch deletes the _ids key unconditionally and stores undefined for every id missing from the sideloaded root, so a payload without the sideload renders phantom rows whose edit and delete actions throw

adjudication.rationale: In store.js `_hydrateEmbedded`, the new plural `_ids` handling (`/(.+)_id(s?)$/` with `m[2]`) does `obj[k].map(id => _lookupSubType(...))` and assigns that array directly to `obj[pluralize(subType)]`, then **always** `delete obj[k]`. If `_lookupSubType` can’t find a sideloaded record for an id in `root`, the mapped element will be `undefined`, so the resulting relationship array can contain `undefined` entries. Because the original `*_ids` key is deleted unconditionally (unlike the singular branch which only deletes when hydrated), the client loses the ids and may render/iterate over `undefined` items (e.g., `{{#each ... as |host|}}`), leading to component code calling properties on `undefined` and throwing. This problematic behavior is directly introduced by the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:5 — category_id is NOT NULL with no foreign key, presence validation or dependent handling, so deleting a category leaves hosts pointing at a missing row and embedded topics silently fall back to uncategorized

adjudication.rationale: The migration creates `embeddable_hosts.category_id` as `null: false` but does not add a foreign key constraint to `categories`, and the `EmbeddableHost` model only has `belongs_to :category` with no explicit validation/cascade behavior. adjudication_records.issue_text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — Hosts are inserted verbatim without the scheme and path stripping the model does, so previously working entries like http://discourse.org never match record_for_host and embeds silently start returning InvalidAccess

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:23 — save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host] with no require, and a nil host value then crashes in the model before_validation, so malformed requests get 500 instead of 400 or 422

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:200 — The new plural hydration branch deletes the _ids key and stores undefined entries when ids cannot be resolved, unlike the singular branch which leaves the payload intact

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 — The host format validation is anchored with \Z instead of \z, so a host value ending in a newline passes validation and is then stored in a form the allowlist lookup can never match.

adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the validation regex ends with \Z: `/\A...\Z/i`. The parsed `uri.host` will not include a newline, so the stored `"example.com\n"` would never match, breaking host_allowed? lookups.
